page.notes: The first word "tiam" is a fragment continued from the previous page. "futuritione" is written whole because the line ends at "futuris" with no printed hyphen; this is an inference, so check it. The left-margin notes "Iacksonian[?]" and "Iuitur[?]" are hard to read and may be wrong. The right margin holds only small marks (a dagger-like sign beside "Arminiani" and "tiam", and a small mark near "relinqui"), which are not legible text. A small asterisk sits below the last line, after "univer-", as an ornament. No catchword is visible.
